title: Policy moves draft -> review -> approved -> active through the full UI workflow with correct badge at each step
preconditions: User has policy.create, policy.update, and policy.approve
steps: As a reviewer, add a comment
expectedResult: Each transition updates the status badge correctly and is reflected in /:policyId/workflow-history with the correct actor and timestamp for every step.

title: Generating a policy from a template pre-fills content and framework mapping correctly
expectedResult: New policy is created in draft status with the template's content pre-filled and any template-associated control mappings carried over.

title: Admin can restore a soft-deleted policy and it reappears in the active list with full version history intact
steps: Navigate to the policy list and open the restored policy's version history
expectedResult: Policy reappears in the active list, and all prior versions/comments/workflow history are still present and unaffected by the delete/restore cycle.
